_about: Euripides in English, translator per title. Complete in two translators: Arthur S. Way (verse, 1894-98, 3 vols., English only; raw IA OCR) and Edward P. Coleridge (prose, 1891, 2 vols., raw IA OCR). Also T. A. Buckley (prose, Bohn) vol. I clean on Gutenberg, Michael Wodhull's 1782 verse in Morley's Universal Library selection (1888), and Gilbert Murray's verse plays (early 1900s; Gutenberg clears them as US PD; Murray d. 1957, not PD in life+70 countries). Publication years are given only where checked in the file; Murray's per-play years were not, so they are left out. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
